consequence: A site-aware model may estimate a descriptive Oshima-versus-post difference while accounting for repeated seasons/species, but the second-boundary coefficient remains inseparable from an Oshima-specific site effect because Oshima is the only bridge-state geographic unit. Species-level 8/8 directions cannot be treated as eight independent boundary replications.
next_design_gain: Independent geographic replication of the bridge pollinator regime, a temporal regime transition within a site, or an external matched-site design is required for a causal boundary effect. Until then, use the network layer as contemporary functional context and falsification of universal-response claims.
